newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Perrier completes Romania mineral water plant.
newsitem.headline: Perrier completes Romania mineral water plant.

text.p: Perrier Vittel Romania, part of Paris-based Perrier Vittel Groupe Nestle, said on Wednesday it had completed a mineral water bottling plant in Romania for a $10 million investment.
The plant, the group's first investment presence in the Balkan country, has a capacity of 4,000 1.25-litre bottles per hour, a Perrier Vittel statement said.
The greenfield project was started in Miercurea Ciuc, in the mineral-water-rich Transylvanian county of Harghita, late in 1996.
The new plant, to be officially inaugurated on Thursday, will start marketing its 'Anavie' sparkling mineral water over the next few weeks.

Perrier Vittel Romania assistant manager Raluca Sandu told Reuters the plant's output would be initially targeted at the local market. "If things go well, we'll add another bottling line to the existing one and start to seek exports to neighbouring countries."
